purpose: Second-official-document corroboration of the slate: the referee-operations injury report prints Game Date / Game Time / Matchup on every row, independently confirming which games exist and their ET tip times. The game-page recheck block corroborates every pick-window row directly against nba.com/games?date= pages.
why_this_matters: FLAG-SLATE-04 exists because www.nba.com/schedule prints tip times as a loose list and is a JavaScript shell (I-05). This document attaches the time to the matchup in the same table row, and the games?date= pages print the tip on the game card - agreement among them upgrades each tip time beyond a single-source claim.
reading_rules: A time is recorded as captured only when a printed row of the PDF carries the time cell.
Where the extraction lost the cell (CHI@MIN, DET@MIA blocks of this release), time_captured is false and the value is filled from the official games-page recheck below - never inferred.

Supersedes data/raw/official_game_times_2026-11-14.json for the 2026-11-14 keys: that file recorded DET@MIA as time_captured=true although its own sibling capture (injury_report_2026-11-14_daybefore.json, record_counts.note + FLAG-INJ-06) documents the cell as lost - irregularity I-02. This file corrects the record; the old file stays committed as history.

time_convention.rule: printed cells are a 12-hour clock with '(ET)' and no meridiem: hour 1-11 -> add 12 (PM); 12:xx -> noon
time_convention.verified_this_session: every 11/15 printed cell re-read against https://www.nba.com/games?date=2026-11-15 (1:00 PM ET, 4:00 PM ET, 4:30 PM ET, 5:00 PM ET, 6:00 PM ET x2, 7:00 PM ET, 8:00 PM ET, 9:00 PM ET)

coverage.not_covered: 2026-11-16..17 games are absent from every release published so far; their tips are re-verified row-by-row in game_page_recheck below and remain FLAG-SLATE-04 until an injury-report release lists them.
